Balwant Rai | Health Insurance Customer Testimonial

Mr. Balwant Rai always prioritised his and his family’s health. When he was diagnosed with a slipped disc and surgery was recommended, he immediately worried about the financial burden. But with TATA AIG’s support, his journey was smooth and worry-free. His hospitalisation expenses were covered with the convenience of cashless facility and his pre and post expenses were reimbursed in no time.
Sagar Sunil Jambhale | Health Insurance Customer Testimonial

Mr. Jambhale wisely invested in TATA AIG Health Insurance for his parents, and it proved to be a lifesaver during a crisis. When his mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, it was a challenging time for the entire family. Thanks to TATA AIG, they didn’t have to worry about financial burden. With cashless treatment for all her care, the Jambhale family found much-needed relief during this difficult phase.​ ​
Satpal Singh | Car Insurance Customer Testimonial

Mr. Satpal Singh enjoys the comfort of driving to work every day in his car. However, during one of his commutes, heavy traffic caused a car to hit his vehicle from behind, causing it to collide with another car. He immediately rushed to the service centre, where a TATA AIG surveyor promptly assessed the damage. The entire claim process was quick and hassle-free, with cashless settlement and smooth paperwork.
Mr. Ravi Bothra | Fire Insurance Customer Testimonial

On June 18, 2023, a fire devastated Blisstering Electronics Pvt. Ltd's business in Noida. Once TATA AIG's claims team was informed about the loss, they acted immediately to address the setback faced by this SME. Our prompt action and dedication led to the swift settlement of a Rs. 1.3 crore claim, showcasing our commitment to helping businesses recover quickly from unforeseen events. This rapid payment of the claim underlines our promise at TATA AIG: "With you Always."

Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited is a joint venture company between Tata Group and American International Group (AIG). Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited celebrates 25 years of service as on 2026, since it commenced operations in India on January 22, 2001. The Company has grown strongly to emerge as the preferred private general insurance company in India with several pioneering firsts to its credit. Driven by a mission to create better tomorrows for Customers by delivering trustworthy and innovative risk solutions, Tata AIG’s broad portfolio of protection covers are backed by years of professional expertise in product offerings, exceptional service capabilities and seamless claims process management. The Company offers a wide range of general insurance covers for businesses and individuals including a comprehensive range of general insurance products for Liability, Marine Cargo, Personal Accident, Travel, Rural-Agriculture Insurance, Extended Warranty etc. As on March 31, 2026, Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited recorded its Gross Written Premium (GWP) at 20,749 Cr, With 262 offices spread across the country, Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited has a robust multi-channel distribution network of 1,17,000+ plus licensed agents including POSP, 980+ licensed brokers and bancassurance partners; a workforce of 9,000+ employees, including 750+ full time claim experts, spread over 266 locations, tie-ups with 12000+ workshops and 13000+ network hospitals and worldwide network of claim servicing partners and a dedicated customer service & operations team, consistently delivering superior service experiences, powered by the latest innovations in technology.
